articles.title: Yankees, Gerrit Cole downplay worries amid home run barrage: 'He'll be fine'
articles.description: Cole hasn't looked great in his last couple of starts. The Yankees don't have much more time for him to figure it out.

articles.title: Cody Bellinger, Ben Rice homer with FDNY bats on 9/11. They hope to auction them for charity

articles.title: Yankees and their stars, including Derek Jeter, mark 9/11 anniversary during Subway Series

articles.title: Fan runs onto Yankee Stadium field waving Palestinian flag at 9:11 p.m. on 9/11 anniversary

articles.title: Why the Yankees play 'God Bless America' at every game, a post-9/11 tradition that endures

articles.title: Yankees' Anthony Volpe makes exhilarating return to majors: 3 takeaways
